scope: Spirit healer activation admission, resurrection penalties and repeated requests

finding.before: HandleSpiritHealerActivate and SendSpiritResurrect accepted an already living Player. GetNPCIfCanInteractWith admits a nearby neutral spirit healer for a living Player; it is not a dead-only guard. The helper then reapplies half-health resurrection, resurrection sickness at eligible levels and25 percent maximum-durability loss.
finding.reproduction: Against pinned pre-fix final-link game.lib, actual serialized activation at native healer6491 for living Human level10 changed health777 to500 and backpack item25 durability35 to27. The regression rejected those changes. No corpse was needed.
finding.fix: Reject null or alive Player in both the packet handler and direct resurrection helper, before interaction/feign-death side effects or resurrection penalties. Existing dead-player paths, including missing corpse and no ghost aura, are retained.

checks: Canonical Release worldserver and bnetserver built with cmake --build build-extractors --config Release --target worldserver bnetserver -- /m:2 /nologo. Original generated final-link game.lib path retained; no OutDir override or runtime configuration change.

Test-CorpseRestartNative.ps1 -VerifyReleaseBinary passes78 spirit cases:13 modes x Human/Orc x levels10/15/20. These include72 serialized/decoded SpiritHealerActivate packet cases and6 direct helper calls on living Players;18 cases permit resurrection and60 reject it.

Native template6491 is used with actual model/template admission, neutral faction35 and NPC flags16385. Each case asserts an initially living Player can pass the shared interaction function, proving that function alone does not prevent this regression. Death/repop, corpse SQL persistence, native item templates/addons and inventory placement run against schema-only scratch databases.

Nearby dead valid, missing-corpse and unreleased-state controls retain50 percent health resurrection and clear8326/ghost/corpse. Each permitted request applies one native25 percent maximum-durability loss to a real backpack item25:35 to27. No synthetic item metadata or modeled damage handler is used.

With fixture sickness start level11, level10 gets none, level15 gets five minutes and level20 gets ten minutes through actual ResurrectPlayer spell15007. After reducing remaining sickness duration by2000ms and setting health321, a repeated packet preserves health321, durability27 and the same sickness duration. There are18 repeated successful-request controls.

Initially alive and direct-alive controls preserve health777, durability35 and no sickness. Dead controls reject horizontal/vertical100-yard separation, wrong NPC flag, despawned healer, foreign map, foreign instance, different phase and unknown GUID. Rejected requests retain death/health/corpse pointer and saved SQL corpse GUID; accepted requests delete resurrectable SQL rows.

Existing48 reclaim cases, separate-process corpse save/startup loading, startup/runtime expiry, missing-corpse login component and exact corpse GUID controls also pass. Native DBErrors is empty and no Server ERROR is emitted. Schema-only scratch databases and their SQL user are removed.

New Test-SpiritHealerRelease.ps1 uses actual final-link game.lib, canonical PE and native source/input hashes. Native ABI reports Unit death-state offset2584 (0xA18), with ALIVE statically required to be0. Exception-bounded disassembly resolves incremental thunks and verifies both entry points compare ALIVE before calls, with a branch directly to a side-effect-free return epilogue. Both bodies retain calls to native resurrection and durability loss; the handler contains an inlined helper.

Validation-owned hidden worldserver PID25128 reached ready and exited gracefully0. Startup DBErrors/stderr are empty and Server.log has no ERROR entries. No worldserver/bnetserver remains running. Runtime binaries are in build-extractors/bin/Release; configs, certificates, DLLs, extracted data and logs directories are preserved.

source_comparison.primary: Local native Player::GetNPCIfCanInteractWith, NPCHandler activation/helper, item durability and ResurrectPlayer code, current template6491 and runtime DB2 item/spell catalogs.
source_comparison.qualification: The current sibling TrinityCore handler/helper has a similar resurrection/penalty flow; it is supporting source comparison, not retail7.3.5 packet evidence or proof that living activation is intended. The local executable reproduction establishes the defect.

retained_failures: .codex/spirit-healer-reference.log: first fixture attempted inventory admission before loading item templates and initializing backpack slots. It failed before any spirit request. Fixture now loads real ItemSparse/addon data and supplies16 native backpack slots; no production inventory change.

.codex/spirit-healer-reproduction.log: corrected fixture against the preserved pre-fix library fails on the first living activation with health500/durability27, reproducing the actual bug. Baseline library SHA and commit are retained in build-extractors/runtime-test/spirit-healer-reference.

First post-fix .codex/spirit-healer-native.log passed all78 cases. Final run also wires the new canonical Spirit Release checker into the wrapper and records its source hash; all native and Release checks pass.
limits: Socketless Players, fixture-spawned native healer6491 and direct decoded-handler invocation are used. This does not authenticate a client or exercise network opcode dispatch, gossip confirmation UI, client-visible ghost models or packet arrival ordering.

Character tables remain empty: corpse SQL rows and backpack item state are checked, but no persistent character health/flags/sickness reload or aggregate Player::LoadFromDB is claimed. Native SaveToDB may UPDATE absent character rows during corpse conversion.

All successful ghost/corpse positions share the same native graveyard. Transfer to a different corpse graveyard, its admission/ACK/logout, equipped/banked item penalties, feign-death aura preservation, transport interaction and exact interaction-radius boundaries are not newly verified.

Client confirmation of Spirit Healer dialog, sickness display/duration, durability, resurrection movement/camera/pet state and visuals remains pending. Startup and binary inspection do not verify those.
next_candidate: Spirit healer transfer to the corpse graveyard when ghost and corpse have different nearest graveyards, including logout and repeated requests.
